description: RAG: count + content assertion. Verifies the deductible definition AND the HomeShield standard tier list are both retrieved (≥2 chunks). Grounded in §2 Definitions and §6.1 Zava HomeShield.

items.prompt: What is a deductible and what standard deductible options are available for Zava HomeShield homeowners policies?
items.expected_response: A deductible is the amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket before the insurer begins to pay on a covered claim (§2 Definitions & Key Terms). For Zava HomeShield homeowners policies, the Standard Deductible Options are $500, $1,000, $2,500, $5,000, and $10,000 (§6.1 Zava HomeShield — Coverage Limits & Structure). Source: 2026-03-25-zava-claims-insurance-policy-guidebook.docx.
